description: TARC Discloses ED Search in Regulatory Filing
notes: TARC Limited informed the stock exchanges about a search conducted by the Enforcement Directorate at its premises. The company's disclosure clarified that the search pertains to a pre-demerger entity and a transaction from before 2020, and it does not anticipate any material impact on its operations.

description: TARC Discloses SEBI-Ordered Forensic Audit into Financial Statements
notes: TARC Limited formally disclosed to the stock exchanges that SEBI has initiated a forensic audit of its financials for FY21-FY23 due to concerns about its disclosure practices. The company has pledged its full cooperation with the audit.

description: Auditor of Material Subsidiary Resigns
notes: The statutory auditor for TARC Projects Limited, a material subsidiary of TARC Ltd, resigned in August 2026. The stated reason was to align the auditor's tenure with that of the parent company, with the firm confirming no other material reasons for the departure.

description: Auditor of Material Subsidiary TARC Projects Limited Resigns
notes: The statutory auditor of TARC's subsidiary, TARC Projects Limited, has resigned to align their tenure with that of the parent company's auditor. The auditor's letter cited no other material reasons for the resignation.
